context: The data are from the pinned PokeMiners Game Master snapshot; the only values needed here are Mewtwo's base stats (Attack 300, Defense 182, Stamina 214) and the level 25 CP multiplier 0.667934. A weather-boosted raid catch is always level 25 and each IV is from 10 to 15 inclusive. CP = floor(max(10, (300 + Attack IV) * sqrt(182 + Defense IV) * sqrt(214 + HP IV) * 0.667934^2 / 10)); max HP = floor(max(10, (214 + HP IV) * 0.667934)). Appraisal stars: 0 stars below sum 23, 1 star at 23–29, 2 at 30–36, 3 at 37–44, 4 at 45. Include every IV triple in range whose computed CP and max HP match the reported values, with its possible level(s); for weather-raid the only possible level is 25. If none matches, the spreads array is empty.
